_about: SSO's five string sections' Performance legato transitions as plain Performance plays them (velocity 64 attacks and transitions, the note before held 24 ms into the next, CC1 64, CC11 127, CC119 written by the script from the spacing as played: [slurs] speedFromWritten 0, Recommended): ms from B's note-on to its f0 leave / MIDPOINT / arrive (0.1 / 0.5 / 0.9 of the way from A's written pitch to B's; YIN, measure_patch.py), by the note before (attack after silence / transition in a run Z A B / an attack 45 ms after a staccato), its written length L (136 .. 2182 ms), B's relative early send r (B sent r ms before its written time, the note before not: the played spacing L - r), B's own length (136 / 300 ms; a note C follows by transition, as early as B) and the interval (+-2 in 'main'; quarter tones spelled and bent as [slurs] microtoneBends 1 sends them, in 'interval' as the difference from +-2). Pooled over 3 pitches per section and 2 takes (ABBA, 1.6 s silences: round robins reset), random modulators on (as shipped). Measured 2026-10-22 on the Windows test VM: Kontakt 8 + SSO, the VM MuseScore's setups (library defaults, max voices 512), offline, kthost (tools/soundlibraries/kthost) through measure_patch.py. 'fixedPoint': the early send that puts the midpoint on 'target' (ms against the written beat: real sections' slurred midpoints, -3 ms upper strings / +19 Celli and Basses, spheres_legato_transitions.json) in a run (r = 0: e = delay(L, 0) - target) and as a slur's first transition after an attack sent plainAttack early; midNowMs: the midpoint as Recommended plays it now (every note plainShift early). For a proposed [slurs] transitionsEarly mode 4; the renderer doesn't read this file.
